title: Is It Cheaper to Hire a Freelancer or an Agency for Marketing? UK Costs 2026
meta_title: Freelancer or Agency for Marketing: Which Is Cheaper? (UK)
meta_description: A UK marketing freelancer costs £200–£500 a day, agencies £1,000–£5,000+ a month. Compare freelancer vs agency vs subscription costs and risks for 2026.
keywords: is it cheaper to hire a freelancer or an agency for marketing

faq.q: Is it cheaper to hire a freelancer or an agency for marketing?
faq.a: For a single skill, a freelancer is usually cheaper. For several skills at once, an agency or a marketing subscription can cost less than hiring and managing multiple freelancers.

faq.q: How much does a marketing freelancer cost in the UK?
faq.a: Typically £25 to £75 an hour or £200 to £500 a day, depending on skill and experience.

faq.q: How much does a marketing agency cost per month in the UK?
faq.a: Small-business retainers usually start around £1,000 and can go well beyond £5,000 a month.

faq.q: Can I try ContentFellow before paying?
